conclusion: The injected KeeperException causes the master to abort by explicit source policy. The test then fails its master-is-alive assertion and runs teardown. Teardown stops the region server, which makes its pending target loop throw the exact IOException by design. The target exception is a shutdown observation after the test has already failed; these trials do not establish a new coordination bug.

source_evidence.finding: start() performs the injected watchAndCheckExists call at line 75 and explicitly catches KeeperException, calling abortable.abort at line 86.

The master starts ZKNodeTracker from HRegionServer construction; rs0 waits for master address in blockAndCheckIfStopped. stop sets this.stopped=true at line 2602; the target at lines 1051-1054 deliberately throws IOException when that stopped flag is observed while still waiting.
HMaster construction invokes HRegionServer construction, so the master0 tracker abort policy applies before master startup completes.
testBootRegionServerFirst starts rs0 before master0. startMaster asserts master.isAlive at line 80. @AfterEach always calls cluster.shutdown.
Teardown explicitly calls stop("Shutdown requested") on every region server at line 276.
